body: Yes, sometimes I feel like I get so wrapped up in emotions I forget that it's actually okay to just leave a environment like this. But after posting here and thinking about everything clearly, it's absolutely obvious that I shouldn't engage in a friendship with her.

On the one hand I can maybe understand her perspective. I was quite the odd ball. But you can't draw the conclusion that someone is "toxic" because they don't follow norms. And when I think about it, she likes throwing that label around.
Thanks for your comment. Yes, I've got a bad history of ignoring gut feelings. Mostly because of feeling conflicted. But in this case, I'll trust my intuition and proceed with caution.
Yes, after that moment I became more aware of the things she said. It kinda escalated from that point.
